target_objectives: Explain that AI models use probability and statistics to generate responses.

scenes.comment: Definition slide: Artificial Intelligence (AI) - what it is and what it can do
scenes.speech: First, let's pin down what AI actually is. Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a technology that mimics human intelligence. It can understand language, recognize patterns, and make decisions.

Vocabulary

Artificial Intelligence (AI)

A technology that mimics human intelligence - understanding language, recognizing patterns, and making decisions.

scenes.comment: The dog barked at the... - showing student guesses alongside AI output
scenes.speech: In Level 1, you predicted what would complete the sentence: 'The dog barked at the...' You probably guessed something like squirrel, mailman, or stranger. When you sent that same prompt to AI Chat, its answer was likely pretty similar.

scenes.comment: Key insight: humans and AI both predict the most likely next word
scenes.speech: That's because both you and the AI were doing the same thing - predicting the most likely word to come next.

Both Doing the Same Thing

Predicting the most likely word to come next.

scenes.comment: Definition: Probability - likelihood scale with word frequency examples
scenes.speech: That process is called probability - the likelihood that a specific outcome might occur. AI has been trained on thousands of sentences. It knows that after 'The dog barked at the,' words like 'mailman' show up way more often than 'calculator.' So it picks the word with the highest probability.

scenes.html: Word Probability

scenes.comment: Key insight: AI picks by frequency, not meaning
scenes.speech: AI isn't deciding what makes sense - it's just picking whatever shows up most often in its training data.
scenes.elevenlabs: [thoughtful] AI isn't deciding what makes sense - it's just picking whatever shows up most often in its training data.

scenes.html:
AI Isn't Deciding What Makes Sense

It's picking whatever shows up most often in its training data.

scenes.comment: Successful predictions slide - completions: door, thank you, pencils
scenes.speech: When patterns are strong, probability works really well. Your lesson showed examples AI completed correctly: 'He heard a knock at the... door.' 'As the bell rang, they put down their... pencils.' These worked because AI had seen those phrase patterns thousands of times. High probability - right answer.

scenes.html: When Patterns Are Strong

scenes.comment: Failed prediction: 'Draw the keys are on the table' with resulting odd image
scenes.speech: But probability has limits. When given 'Draw the keys are on the table,' AI produced an image of a single key sitting awkwardly on a table. It got some individual words right, but completely missed what the sentence actually meant.

scenes.html: But Probability Has Limits

scenes.comment: What AI did: focused on key/on/table - definition of abstraction introduced
scenes.speech: Here's why. AI focused on the words 'key,' 'on,' and 'table,' and abstracted away everything else. Abstraction means focusing on only the essential details and ignoring everything else.
scenes.elevenlabs: [thoughtful] Here's why. AI focused on the words 'key,' 'on,' and 'table,' and abstracted away everything else. Abstraction means focusing on only the essential details and ignoring everything else.

scenes.html: Here's Why

scenes.comment: Why abstraction failed here - AI uses statistics, not meaning
scenes.speech: AI decided those three words were the important ones - and it was wrong. That's the tricky part: AI abstracts based on statistics, not meaning. When meaning depends on context, AI can miss it.
scenes.elevenlabs: [thoughtful] AI decided those three words were the important ones - and it was wrong. That's the tricky part: AI abstracts based on statistics, not meaning. When meaning depends on context, AI can miss it.

scenes.html:
Statistics, Not Meaning

AI abstracts based on what appears together most often - not what the words actually mean in context.

scenes.comment: Summary: AI + probability + abstraction - vocabulary review
scenes.speech: So here's how it all fits together. AI uses probability to decide what to generate next, and abstraction to figure out which parts of your input matter. When patterns are clear, AI does really well. When meaning depends on more than just the words, it can fall short. That's the key to understanding how AI works - and it's the foundation for the rest of this unit.
